---
title: "New collaboration project launched: VLAIO BirdWise"
date: "2026-10-01"
description: "Reducing bird-induced crop losses in open-field and fruit cultivation"
---

On 1 October 2026, the VLAIO BirdWise research project officially started. Led by HOGent, with UHasselt (CMK) as a partner, this project focuses on an integrated approach to reducing bird-induced crop losses in open-field and fruit cultivation.

Partners: HOGent (lead), UHasselt (CMK), INBO, UGent, Inagro, pcfruit, Viaverda, and APB Hooibeekhoeve.
